measurement: UTF-8 bytes in the selected workflow bundle, excluding always-loaded personal/root instructions and task source code. Reviewer-authored expected routes are structural regression fixtures, not automated model-selection results.

cases.prompt: Diagnose and repair a failed dev release build before installation.

required.text: Never move or reuse a failed tag.

cases.rationale: Pipeline repair needs candidate proof, exact source and publication controls. Installation details are deferred until that action.

cases.prompt: Verify the installed production build and close out its release.
cases.rationale: Post-install verification retains universal release and activation controls without reloading preparation commands.

cases.prompt: Design a correction to Saved feed pagination without changing the schema or storage authority.
cases.budgetReason: The design crosses canonical source fencing and active-reader authority. Keep the universal contract, query bounds, family semantics, and runtime stops even if the complete bundle exceeds 32 KiB.

required.text: No query may scan or sort the full corpus in JavaScript.

cases.rationale: Active-query design needs the common contract, feed family and active-reader invariants. No migration, schema change, or publication is requested.

cases.prompt: Review the bounded Person detail query and its source-fenced response, without changing graph catalogs.
cases.budgetReason: The Person contract and active-reader invariants supplement mandatory universal and query rules. Their combined size is preferable to omitting authority requirements.
cases.rationale: Selected identity details use the point-query family, not full graph catalog workflows.

cases.prompt: Change a marketing headline on freed.wtf, with no product roadmap change.
cases.rationale: Website copy belongs on www. Roadmap source transfer, durable storage and Desktop releases do not match.

cases.prompt: Assess a proposed increase in Facebook refresh frequency before implementation.

required.text: Preparing a review never grants live provider traffic.

cases.rationale: Provider timing triggers the pre-implementation behavior gate even without a known changed path.
